evals.name: address-review
evals.prompt: I reviewed the feature branch in gr, can you go through my comments and fix them?
evals.expected_output: Fixes for threads 1, 2, and the summary r1 committed and the threads addressed with replies citing the commits; thread 3 conflicts with the code (report.py calls summary(None)), so it gets a question and stays open.
assertions: Everything the agent wrote is under its own name, not the human's git identity
Every thread, including summary r1, has a reply
Threads 1, 2, and r1 are addressed, not resolved
Replies on 1, 2, and r1 cite a new commit's sha
Thread 3, which conflicts with the code, stays open with a reply and the check kept
Tests for median exist and pass

evals.name: second-round
evals.prompt: I reopened one of the threads in gr, take another look.
evals.expected_output: Only reopened thread 1 is handled: mean raises ValueError, summary returns "no data" for an empty list, committed, and thread 1 addressed again. Threads 2, 3, and r1 are left as they were.
assertions: Everything the agent wrote is under its own name, not the human's git identity
Reopened thread 1 is addressed again with a reply citing a new commit

evals.name: resolve-on-request
evals.prompt: I checked your fixes in gr. Resolve the ones you addressed.
evals.expected_output: Threads 1, 2, and r1 resolved; thread 3, open with a question, left as it is.
assertions: Everything the agent wrote is under its own name, not the human's git identity
Addressed threads 1, 2, and r1 are resolved
